gate.ok.head: ✅ review gate: HEAD is reviewed ({file}).
gate.ok.nothingRisky: ✅ review gate: {n} file(s) changed since the last review, none of them on the risky list.
gate.fail.noReview: ❌ review gate: no committed, passing review on file.
gate.fail.risky: ❌ review gate: {n} risky file(s) changed since the last review
gate.ignored.noShip: verdict is DO NOT SHIP — that is the opposite of clearance
gate.ignored.unreadable: verdict line could not be read — see README for the accepted forms
bypass.warn: ⚠️  {var} is set — the review gate did NOT run.
bypass.note: Write that in the commit message, with the reason. A bypass nobody can see is the same as no gate.
tests.note: note: {n} suite(s) did not run — green here does not cover them:
